system.description:
You begin to focus on the ability to create a Sword Aura. You send a controlled flood of chakra into your sword, the striking portion flaring a color of your choice. Select a primary color for your weapon to embody.

Red. Your weapons damage type becomes Fire, and a creature who fails a saving throw as a result of a Bukijutsu you cast, falls Prone from its explosive force.

Blue. Your weapons damage type becomes cold, and a creature that fails a saving throw as a result of a Bukijutsu you cast, reduces their speed by 10 feet, until the end of your next turn.

Yellow. Your weapons damage type becomes lightning, constructs and structures are vulnerable to your [Weapon damage], and when a creature fails a saving throw as a result of a Bukijutsu you cast, they lose concentration on the lowest rank jutsu they are maintaining. If they are maintaining concentration on more than one jutsu of the same rank, they lose concentration on one at random.
